latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Architecture Decision Record Creator skill.

- Enables users to create structured Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) with 7 distinct sections for documenting architecture decisions and their justification.
- Guides on when and how to document decisions, including assessing architectural significance using five key dimensions.
- Includes instructions for establishing context, identifying alternatives, and determining appropriate ADR status (Proposed, Accepted, Superseded, RFC).
- Provides recommendations for organizing ADRs and numbering, including detection of existing records in various codebase directories.
- Designed to promote rigor and transparency in technical decision-making for teams and individuals.
